biotools.summary:
RARe, the French Network of Biological Resource Centers for Research in Biology, Agronomy, and the Environment (https://www.agrobrc-rare.org/), is a research infrastructure included in the national roadmap. It brings together five BRC networks that preserve genetic, genomic, and biological resources collected and characterized through research on domestic animals, model or cultivated plants, wild species related to domestic animals, forest trees, microorganisms of agronomic or agri-food interest, and environmental microorganisms and organisms.
The goal of the RARe portal is to facilitate the discovery of and access to these data.
It is based on the DataDiscovery tool, which aims to provide researchers with quick and easy access to relevant biological data using specific keywords and filters. This generic tool is easily customizable for specific filters, environments, or data schemas.
